scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && npm --prefix functions run test:unit
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-truchicount --only auth,firestore,functions "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration/*.test.mjs functions/test/*-emulator.test.mjs"
scripts.deploy:hosting:checked: npm run test:all && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:rules:checked: npm run test:all && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules
